description: This file defines the 'Tags' feature's list operation, including a query type and a handler that retrieves ordered tags from a database context.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Request type for fetching tags, implementing MediatR's IRequest to return a TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query by retrieving tags from the database context, ordering them, and returning in a TagsEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the Query request asynchronously by fetching ordered tags from the database context.
